title: First Encounters
tagline: Two communities meet. Neither knows what comes next.

approval.evidence: User directives in IRGS Campaign Design conversation; earlier drafted concept text.

public.setting_label: First Nations and European communities in North America
public.synopsis: Experience an early encounter between a specific First Nations community and European arrivals, from either side and from multiple possible social positions. Outcomes depend on languages, previous contacts, trade interests, property and land relationships, authority, and what each participant actually knows. Cooperation, cautious coexistence, refusal, and conflict are all feasible; no one outcome is predetermined.

design.scope_statement: Localized bounded incident with player freedom and simulated external activity
design.core_3_3_verification: document_reference_only; runtime capability not certified by this catalogue
design.core_integration_policy: inherit Core; propose upstream changes by CMRR; do not replicate shared resource/state owners
design.player_agency_requirement: Do not invent player speech, thoughts, motives, travel, allegiance, or voluntary decisions.
design.persistent_state_requirement: Maintain coherent records of actors, knowledge, time, possessions, ownership, transit, work, and consequences.
design.sensitive_context_review: specific historical/Indigenous cultural research and appropriate cultural consultation required

filters.setting: First Nations and European communities in North America
